== Biography ==
Janet’s birth is estimated about 1794. Her death year remains disputed between an inherited 1845 claim and the 1843 record described below.



Mrs. Janet Glasgow

    Record Type: Deaths & Burials
    Data Set: Calton Burials Index
    Buried: 26 May 1843
    Location: Britain & Ireland, Calton, Glasgow, Scotland
    Surnames: Gilmour, Glasgow

Aged: 51: Cause of Death: dropsy.


== Research Notes ==
=== Calton record and disputed dates ===

The inherited birth and death claims are 1794 and 1845. The Calton burial account above instead gives 26 May 1843, age 51, with the surnames Gilmour and Glasgow and dropsy noted. That exact event, age and surname combination identifies this profile's recorded subject with the woman indexed in the related parish transcript, rather than requiring another Janet.

The parish transcript names Mrs Janet “Gilmour Or Glasgow”, aged 51, and labels 26 May 1843 as death. It gives Glasgow, OPR 644/67, item 3, page 281.<ref name="Janet1843OPR">Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Deaths & Burials 1564–2017'', [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBUR%2F1185627 Janet Gilmour Or Glasgow, SCOT/OPR/BUR/1185627], OPR 644/67, item 3, page 281, register range 1837–1854; title Mrs, age 51, death label 26 May 1843, Glasgow. Derivative transcript inspected 4 November 2026; original register uninspected.</ref> The Calton companion labels that same date as burial, calls her Mrs Glasgow and records dropsy.<ref name="Janet1843Calton">Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Deaths & Burials 1564–2017'', [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=GBPRS%2FGLASGOW%2FBUR%2F093165&tab=this Janet Glasgow, GBPRS/GLASGOW/BUR/093165], burial 26 May 1843, Calton, age 51, dropsy; held derivative transcript reviewed 24 October 2026. Original register uninspected.</ref> These are probable companion derivatives, not independent witnesses. The death-versus-burial labels must be checked against the original before choosing an exact death date. Age 51 suggests birth about 1791–1792; the indexed 1792 is calculated from age, not a recorded birthday.

“Gilmour Or Glasgow” supplies two recorded surnames without explicitly identifying which was her birth surname. Her present Gilmour birth surname is not changed by this comparison. The transcript names no husband, parent, child or informant. It therefore does not establish that the 1819 Robert Glasgow groom was [[Glasgow-1538|Robert Glasgow]], Margaret Brash's husband, or prove the parentage of any attached child. Existing family attachments retain their separate evidence limits.

[[Glasgow-3066|Janet (Glasgow) Scott]] has a different Calton account: burial 9 July 1840, aged 49, fever, surnames Glasgow and Scott. That specific earlier burial conflicts with an identification as this 1843 decedent; approximate age and locality alone should not transfer the later event to her.
